_doc: Fernis D Man's line bank (Documentation/CORE_DESIGN_PASS_2026-11-17.md, D9.1-D9.9). A small devil on your shoulder: finds things truthfully, gives the opposite of good advice, finds your suffering hilarious. Moments are keyed by event; 'big' moments always speak, small ones roll smallChance; at most one line per hero swing. Lines by class (barbarian / warrior / rogue / wizard) fall back to 'any'. Tokens: {hero} {enemy} {turns} {links} {cause} {hp} {status}. Draft lines: REVIEW in the step 11 lore pass.
speaker: Fernis

any: {turns}. I've seen faster funerals, but fine.
{enemy} is down. I'd call that a win if I were generous. I'm not.
Done in {turns}. Next time try losing, it's more interesting for me.
barbarian: You hit it until it stopped. Truly the thinking man's approach.
warrior: Very tidy. Very sensible. I nearly fell asleep on your shoulder.
rogue: Death by a thousand cuts. Well, a few. Your mother would be so proud.
wizard: Magic. Big lights. It died. I'm told that's a career.

any: You were at {hp}% and you WON? I'd already sold your boots.
Back from the brink. Disgusting. I had a whole eulogy ready.
Here lies {hero}. Tried hard. Rolled a one.
Well. That's the end of my free ride.
{enemy} wins. I'll be on its shoulder now. No hard feelings.
barbarian: Died swinging. Mostly at air, but swinging.
warrior: All that armor, and it still found the soft bit.
rogue: Quick, clever, dead. Two out of three.
wizard: You read every book except the one about not dying.

any: {links} links! I'd clap, but I'm holding a tiny fork.
The whole strip, start to finish. Don't let it go to your head. Too late.
{links} in a row. Do that again and I might have to respect you.
Chain's gone. {cause}. I'm writing it down.
And there goes the combo. {cause}. Beautiful.
{cause} cost you a link. Keep doing that, it's hilarious.
It was already dead. You kept going. I love you a little.
Overkill. Rude to the corpse, honestly.
That hit had leftovers. Somebody take them home.
{hp}% HP. I'm updating my will. You're not in it.
You're about to die. Stand still, it's quicker.
Low health! Great time to try your slowest card.
Its chain is at {links}. This is the part where you worry.
{enemy} is building something. Ignore it, I'm sure it's nothing.
{links} links on the other side. Don't block. Blocking is for cowards.
{status}. New toy. I'd be furious.
Ooh, {status}. You'll hate this. I already love it.
Out alive. Your best chain was {links}. I've had longer naps.
Dungeon done. I counted every mistake. It's a long list.
We made it out. Next time take the scary door, trust me.
